title: Effectiveness of Large Language Models in Simulating Regional Psychological Structures: An Empirical Examination of Personality and Subjective Well-being

bias_targets.methodology: Generating virtual participants via role-playing prompts matching specific regional identities (Chinese provinces/municipalities) and comparing their simulated Big Five personality and subjective well-being (SWB) scores against real large-scale survey data to detect amplified regional stereotypes and structural deviations.
